# Ayman Alawwad

> PMO Manager · Portfolio & Program Management. Bridging strategy and execution through portfolio governance. Ten-plus years leading projects, programs and portfolios across technology, infrastructure, construction and government environments in Saudi Arabia.

Also written: Ayman Al-Awwad, Ayman AlAwwad, Ayman Alawad, أيمن العواد.
